purpose: Define how authenticated identity and assurance context are attached to runtime sessions/requests and propagated across local/remote operations without turning session handles into semantic identity.

topics.name: Session Identity Propagation
topics.purpose: Define how authenticated identity and assurance context are attached to runtime sessions/requests and propagated across local/remote operations without turning session handles into semantic identity.

semantics.session_rule: Session has transient runtime identity distinct from IdentityCore identity.
semantics.binding_rule: Authenticated session binds to an explicit identity plus current assurance context.
semantics.propagation_rule: Calls/requests carry identity/assurance provenance according to the owning protocol/runtime boundary.
semantics.remote_rule: Remote target receives origin identity context while evaluating its own rights/policy.
semantics.transport_rule: Transport/session identifier does not replace semantic identity.
semantics.expiry_rule: Expired/terminated session loses its active authentication binding.
semantics.authority_rule: Session authentication context is input to authorization, not authorization itself.

invariants.rule: Identity lifecycle, authentication assurance, credential state and session state remain explicit and cannot be inferred from authorization, transport or profile data.

hard_gates.condition: session id used as semantic person/org identity
remote call loses origin identity context

references.purpose: Remote target evaluates its own rights.
